entities.name: Ethan
entities.description: An individual living with bipolar disorder and an internal persona named Elizah.
entities.quote: Ethan had already developed bipolar disorder from childhood (your canon terminology). ● His darker inner persona (later known as Elizah) already existed.

entities.name: Elizah
entities.description: Ethan's inner persona who became less evil through the influence of Nilanjona.
entities.quote: His darker inner persona (later known as Elizah) already existed. ● The toxic relationship accelerated Elizah's awakening, making that inner self significantly more toxic, angry, and destructive.

entities.name: Derek Miles
entities.description: Grace's partner after her relationship with Ethan ended.
entities.quote: Grace later moves on and eventually builds a life with Derek Miles (Vanguard).

entities.name: Xinea
entities.description: Ethan's final and most compatible partner who understands and accepts both Ethan and Elizah.
entities.quote: Xinea becomes the final and most compatible partner. Like Grace... she notices Ethan's changes. Unlike Grace... she instinctively knows how to handle them.

entities.name: Zayn
entities.description: A figure who maintains independent friendships with the women in Ethan's life.
entities.quote: Zayn's relationship doesn't revolve around Ethan. He has independent relationships with every important woman in Ethan's life.

entities.name: Stitch
entities.description: The entity responsible for separating Ethan and Elizah into distinct bodies.
entities.quote: After Stitch separates Ethan and Elizah... it feels natural that she already understands Elizah.

timeline_events.title: Elizah's Awakening
timeline_events.description: Ethan's darker inner persona was further developed and intensified by a toxic relationship prior to meeting Nilanjona.
timeline_events.quote: The toxic relationship accelerated Elizah's awakening, making that inner self significantly more toxic, angry, and destructive.

timeline_events.title: Nilanjona's Influence
timeline_events.description: The presence of Nilanjona in Ethan's life began to reduce the toxicity of the Elizah persona.
timeline_events.quote: Before Nilanjona: ● Elizah was becoming genuinely toxic. After years beside her: ● he remained sarcastic, ● savage, ● provocative, ● emotionally guarded, but... he stopped becoming evil.

timeline_events.title: Separation of Ethan and Elizah
timeline_events.description: Stitch physically separated the persona of Elizah from Ethan, giving Elizah his own body.
timeline_events.quote: After Stitch separates Ethan and Elizah... it feels natural that she already understands Elizah. Because... she had unknowingly met him many times before.
